text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's the day of the Arima Kinen. The
climax of the
racing year, and of Tokai
Teio's career.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
It's finally here, Trainer. My showdown
with Prez.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
She's who I look up to the most. No
matter what
happens, this race won't
change that.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
The one thing that will change is what
my fans
think of me.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
They'll be like, "Tokai Teio is the best

Umamusume of them all!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you know I will! The crowd's
cheers at the
end of the race will be for
me alone!
choice_data_list_en: Go out there and win, no matter what!
Make sure you come back with a win!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Here I go, Trainer. Don't let me
out of your
sight!
